name: One with the Shadows
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level antipaladin 2, bard 2, legendary ninja 2, magus 2, occultist 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute/level (D)

You bend and twist nearby shadows around you to hide you. You gain a +10 bonus on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness, and as long as you are within 10 feet of an area of dim light or darkness, you can make Stealth checks even when being directly observed and without needing cover or concealment. You cannot hide in your own shadow. This spell does not end when you attack, unlike invisibility, though you are clearly visible when attacking, so your target is not denied its Dexterity bonus against your attacks; however, you can make a Stealth check as a move action (or as part of your movement) immediately after attacking to hide again, as long as there is dim light or darkness within 10 feet.
